stockSelector.title: Which stock should you review first?

pending.statusHint: You can keep going without waiting: add holdings and cash first.
pending.syncHint: The price ladder appears when data is complete
pending.heroDescription: We are updating this stock’s company profile, recent prices, and dividends actually received over the last 12 months. Once the data is complete, the app will show how to split a purchase across price levels.
pending.cardTitle: The reference comes after the data

pending.companyProfileDetail: Read the stock name and sector
pending.trailingDividendDetail: Used to estimate the actual yield

ready.compositionTitle: Every decision in the portfolio has a source
ready.compositionDescription: Suggested amounts are calculated by the backend from budget, holdings, and per-stock limits. This page only presents the result.

guidance.referenceNote: The data is ready to review
guidance.buyDescription: The current price is in the “{zone}” range. This reference is about {amount} ({shares}); split it across the ladder instead of using the budget at once.
guidance.trimDescription: The current price is in the “{zone}” range. This reference is about {amount} ({shares}); handle it in portions rather than selling everything at once.
guidance.reviewDescription: The stock data or price range still needs a review. Keep the cash in reserve until the reference is confirmed.
guidance.holdDescription: The current price is in the “{zone}” range, and there is no action to take now. Keep the existing position steady and check again after a price change.
guidance.foot: This is a dated trading reference, not an automatic order. Record it first, then decide whether to act.

decision.fallbackExplanation: The model has not provided an explanation yet. Sync the complete stock data first.
decision.waitingConfirmation: Waiting for new data to confirm
decision.lastTwelveMonthsFormula: Dividends actually received over the last 12 months ÷ current price · Data as of {date}
decision.zoneReason: Current range: {zone}. The amount is calculated from backend budget and holding rules.
decision.holdingReason: Current holdings: {held} shares, including {core} core shares.
decision.dataFrom: Provided by the data service · Updated on trading days
decision.priceLadderTitle: When should you buy, and how much?
decision.priceLadderDescription: The more attractive the price, the larger the suggested portion. Split the plan so you do not use the budget at once.
decision.ladderLegendMain: Blue marks the priority-buy range; amber marks a small add.
decision.planDescription: {securityName} is configured separately; keep the core position steady.
decision.noSwingTrading: Do not use for swing trades
decision.reevaluate: Review again after a major change
decision.planNote: The suggested amount changes with price, budget, and holdings. It is not an automatic trading instruction.
decision.actualDividend: Dividends actually received over the last 12 months
decision.noFillMissing: Missing data is not filled in
decision.trustDescription: If actual dividend data is missing, the system will not generate a buy signal. Use your own judgment.

signalTitles.strongBuy: Price has entered the test-buy range
signalTitles.accumulate: Yield is back in the acceptable range
signalTitles.trim: Yield is low; protect the position first
signalTitles.noAction: No action is needed right now

decision.priceLadderPendingDescription: Once the actual TTM dividends and market data are synced, the app will calculate five reference ranges.

strongBuy.label: Priority buy
strongBuy.copy: Valuation and yield are both attractive; a larger portion can be considered.

accumulate.label: Add in portions
accumulate.copy: Near the target range; consider a small portion and keep cash in reserve.

hold.label: Watch and hold
hold.copy: Existing holdings can remain; pause new money for now.

partialTrim.label: Trim candidate
partialTrim.copy: Yield is low; consider trimming only when the price moves well away from target.

aggressiveTrim.label: Aggressive trim
aggressiveTrim.copy: Consider only when both position size and rules allow it.
